messages:
Priya: FYI we27re scheduling a staged rebuild of the staging base image next Wed. Requirement: every promoted image must have a KMS-backed attestation before canary. Need a scoped RBAC proposal and audit checklist. Any immediate concerns?
Devon: Ack. Which KMS key and which service account should be able to sign?
Priya: Key: kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Principal: image-builder@redwood-prod.svc. Principle: sign-only (no key management).
Alex: For cosign+KMS on GCP, grant roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on the specific cryptoKey. Do not use keyAdmin.
Sam: Scan found glibc CVE-2024-XXXXX in a transient layer. If we rebuild now CI should pull updated packages. Can we accelerate?
Priya: We can if CI picks updated packages; still want a 48h canary window after canary push.
Julia: CI sign step (example):

```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer" gcr.io/redwood/staging-base:${BUILD_TAG}
```

CI needs roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier on the key and roles/storage.objectViewer on the registry bucket so the signer can pull the image.
Devon: I27ll craft a terraform IAM binding scoped to the single cryptoKey. No list/delete perms granted.
ci-bot: build queued for gcr.io/redwood/staging-base:20260510 — job id 9021
ci-bot: build succeeded (6m) — pushed to staging tag
Sam: I27ll run vuln scan on the signed image and post a package diff. If any remaining critical vulns show, we halt promotion.
oncall-sre: Question: if the signing key is compromised, how do we revoke trust for existing signed images? We can27t remove signatures from pushed images.
Priya: Proposed approach: 1) Maintain an allowlist of approved image digests for runtime admission; admission rejects anything not on that allowlist. 2) If key compromise suspected, rotate key and update allowlist to exclude affected digests; mark images as untrusted in console. 3) Document emergency rotation and allowlist update in runbook.
Alex: Audit plan: enable KMS Admin audit logs and storage Data Access logs for object writes. Sink KMS+storage logs to security project, retention 365d. Add alert on any unexpected IAM binding changes to the cryptoKey.
Julia: Add a verify step in canary pipeline: `cosign verify --key kms://... gcr.io/...` and validate attestation fields (build_id, git_sha, builder_sa). Fail canary if verification fails.
Devon: I27ll open a PR with terraform for the IAM binding and a short runbook for oncall SRE (how to mark images untrusted and perform emergency key rotation). Target EOD.
Priya: Action items:
- Devon: terraform IAM binding for sign-only perms + PR (EOD)
- Julia: add cosign verify to canary pipeline (PR by tomorrow)
- Sam: post vuln diff after scan (in this thread)
- Alex: set up log sinks & retention, post sink name and alert index
- oncall-sre: review revocation/runbook steps and confirm runtime admission semantics

Priya: Thanks everyone — reconvene if Sam finds a blocker. :thumbsup:
